words.example: I use the internet to find information.

words.definition: a machine that helps you write, work, and play
words.example: I do my homework on a computer.

words.definition: a small machine you use to call and talk to people
words.example: I call my mother on my phone.

words.definition: the flat part of a phone or computer where you see pictures

words.definition: a place on the internet with information and pages
words.example: This website has news about sports.

words.definition: short words that you send to someone
words.example: I send a message to my friend.

words.definition: a picture made with a camera

words.definition: moving pictures with sound

words.definition: to let other people see or use something

words.definition: to click a button online to show you enjoy something

words.definition: a short written opinion you leave online

words.definition: a person you know and like

words.definition: connected to the internet

words.example: This app helps me learn English.

words.definition: a secret word that lets you use your account
words.example: Don't share your password with strangers.

words.definition: a message that you send using the internet
words.example: I send an email to my teacher.

words.definition: to save something from the internet onto your device
words.example: I download a new song.

words.definition: to send a file from your device to the internet
words.example: She uploads her holiday photos.

words.definition: to talk with someone using the internet
words.example: We chat every day after school.

text: Today, many people use the internet every day. I use my phone and my computer to go online. In the morning, I check my email and read a message from my teacher. I also open an app to chat with my friends. My best friend often shares funny videos with me. Sometimes I watch a video and I like it, so I click the like button. I also write a comment under my friend's photo. Last week, I took a nice photo at the park and posted it online. Many friends left kind comments. I also learned to download music and upload my own videos to a website. But I am careful with my password because it is private. I never share my password with people I don't know. My screen shows many messages every day, but I try not to use my phone too much. The internet is very useful, but I also like to close my computer and play outside with my real friends.
